{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with severe disease
severe_df = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check for any negative or implausible biomarker values
print('Min biomarker_baseline in severe group:', severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].min())
print('Max biomarker_baseline in severe group:', severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].max())
print('Mean biomarker_baseline in severe group:', severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean())"}
